decision: Scan base: full car 25M tris -> 3 mm decimate -> crop -> prep (car.json canonical frame); every part prepped --like car.json
why: Parts on Drive share the full car's Artec frame (verified: overlay render of all 17 parts sits on the car)

decision: X-ray explode base = full car with the 12 exploded parts carved out (faces within 10 mm of each part scan), car_carved.blend

decision: Exploded parts rendered silver over a grey x-ray car (project copy of scan_render.py with --part-look)
why: All-xray (cyan) test made the parts unreadable against the car; silver parts on grey glass read as 'these are the scanned aero parts'

decision: End card = GT3 RS (992) 3D-scan listing (illumaesthetic.com/products/porsche-911-gt3-rs-3d-scan); final scan shot ends on cam_listing solved by silhouette fit to the listing's 360 viewer (WebZoom frame 0: focus 938,885, scale 1.2)
why: 240SX lesson: end the scan on the listing hero angle and dissolve so it reads as one object; edge error ~6 px

decision: Blender lens shift (sensor_fit HORIZONTAL) is in units of frame WIDTH: cx = W/2 - shift_x*W, cy = H/2 + shift_y*W
why: Measured: shift 0.05 moved the render 52-54 px on a 1080-wide frame in both axes; using the long side put the listing fit 40 px off

decision: Footage found: Dropbox '992 GT3RS scanning' (user's phone, Jan 30 2025): yellow GT3 RS on a lift, front wheels off, crew scanning the front-right arch. Drift-clip plan dropped
why: User remembered scan footage of a yellow car on their phone; it matches the 240SX format (real scanning -> 1:1 -> scan)

decision: 1:1 cut #1: v_0130_125744 @4.500 s head-on (camA = landmark solve, 6 pts, 16.65 mm, RMSE 9 px; GrabCut silhouette agrees) on the 3.80 s hit
why: Strongest onset in the track; head-on frame has headlights, DRLs, lip, windshield spread in depth; ultrawide lens confirmed by solve (16-18 mm on the 20.25 mm sensor)

decision: 1:1 cut #2: v_0130_125720 @5.300 s right side (camC, 8 pts from a side-view raycast, 2 dropped, f fixed 16.65 mm, RMSE 6 px) on the 14.14 s drop; crew scanning plays 2.61-5.33 s
why: v_0130_125703 @9.4 (closer arch frame) only shared the mirror with the scan; 125720 pulls back at its end to show wheel, intake, handle, mirror, wing tip - free focal solve (15.7 mm) agreed with camA's lens

decision: Scan base for all shots after a 1:1 cut: front wheels removed (two connected components); in the reassembly the wheels translate back on with the aero parts
why: Real car is on the lift with both front wheels off; listing render (end card) has wheels, so they return before the dissolve

decision: Car is yawed ~8 deg and centred at y=-0.45 m in the scan frame (raycasts: headlights x 1.75 vs 1.97)
